title: Digital Native Slang, Internet Culture, and Urban Vernacular
grammar: Digital youth vernacular, expressive particles, and informal ellipsis
goal: I can report that linguists disagree about English words in Hungarian slang and say what each side says.
I can use English loanword verbs such as *posztol* and *lájkol* with Hungarian endings.
I can tell a slang sentence from a sentence fit for an official announcement.
